author: driver
content:
Implementation pushed to branch `issue-77-board-class` (commit d823e942).

Changes per design doc `.design/separate-zen-from-board-class.md`:
- `images.board_class TEXT` column derived from socket via `ingest.classify_board_class`
- `primary_images` uniqueness widened to (zen_generation, board_class, type_id) via expression UNIQUE INDEX (NULL collates as '')
- `--board-class` flag added to query/best/stats; export filename pattern is `{board_class}_{gen}_{type}.bin`
- `select` group key triple: (zen_gen, board_class, type_id)
- No migration: README + AGENTS.md document the rebuild-from-content-addressed-ROMs policy
- 367 tests pass (16 new for board_class, including end-to-end zen4-Ryzen-vs-EPYC partition test)

Ready for critical review.
